# Faith Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old (Volume 5)  <sub>[v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c8 P46](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolgirl  <sub>[v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000), [v5 c16 P21](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0021)</sub>
- **Titles:** Red Rose  <sub>[v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065), [v5 c17 P3](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Faith is described as being as pretty as a picture, wearing her beauty like a rose, with golden-brown eyes, golden-brown curls, and crimson cheeks. She has a lively, dimpled face, and when excited or angry, her cheeks flush to a brilliant crimson and her eyes flash.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P12](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0012), [v5 c5 P20](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0020), [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Faith is an energetic, high-spirited, and joyous girl who is a tomboy and a leader in mischief. She is quick-tempered and impulsive, often acting before thinking, but she possesses an unyielding sense of loyalty, honesty, and courage. Beneath her daring exterior, she is fiercely protective of her family, deeply affectioned toward her father, and incapable of bearing malicious grudges.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P30](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0030), [v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031), [v5 c2 P33](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0033), [v5 c5 P20](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0020), [v5 c12 P28](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0028), [v5 c16 P49](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0049), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c16 P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079), [v5 c23 P11](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0011)_

- To reform her and her siblings' behavior through the Good-Conduct Club  <sub>[v5 c23 P67](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0067), [v5 c23 P71](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0071)</sub>

## History

Faith Meredith moved to the Glen St. Mary manse with her widowed father and siblings. Soon after arriving, she and her brothers and sister befriended the Blythe children in Rainbow Valley, as well as an escaped run-away named Mary Vance whom they found hiding in an old barn. After getting into various scrapes that scandalized the congregation, Faith helped establish a 'Good-Conduct Club' with her siblings to self-punish their misdeeds. Following a misunderstanding of days where she and Una cleaned the house on a Sunday, Faith took the pulpit platform in church the next Sabbath to publicly defend her father and explain their error. Later, when the congregation gossiped about her father, she marched to Norman Douglas's home to confront him; after an angry outburst, she won his friendship and convinced him to return to church. When Aunt Martha accidentally slaughtered her beloved pet rooster Adam to cook for a visiting minister, Faith was heartbroken, but was later comforted by Rosemary West, who gifted her a canary. Upon discovering that her father loved Rosemary, Faith privately approached her to clear up misunderstandings, ultimately paving the way for her father's marriage.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P7](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0007), [v5 c2 P11](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0011), [v5 c4 P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000), [v5 c5 P20](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0020), [v5 c10 P34](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0034), [v5 c12 P1](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0001), [v5 c12 P6](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0006), [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029), [v5 c16 P49](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0049), [v5 c16 P59](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0059), [v5 c18 P25](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0025), [v5 c20 P33](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0033), [v5 c23 P59](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0059), [v5 c34 P15](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0015), [v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)_
